40014135.author: पदार्थः
40014135.content: रामः Rama, यथावत्:  in that manner, अभिभाषितम् : spoken , हनुमतः by Hanuman, वाक्यम्: words,श्रुत्वा: having heard, प्रीतिसमायुक्तः filled with love, उत्तरम: replied, वाक्यम्: words, अब्रवीत्: said

40014135.author: Translation
40014135.content: Having heard Hanuman's words, full of love, Rama replied.

40014136.author: पदार्थः
40014136.content: हनुमता: Hanuman, यत्: such , धरणीतले: on this earth, अन्येन:  by any one, मनसापि:  even to think, नशक्यम्: not possible, सुमहत्: mighty, भुवि: world, दुर्लभम्: difficult, कार्यम्: task, कृतम्: has performed.

40014136.author: Translation
40014136.content: "Hanuman You have performed a mighty task indeed, which is difficult even to think of in this world and not possible for any one else on this earth."

40014137.author: पदार्थः
40014137.content: गरुडात्: by Garuda( the vehicle of Visnu ), वायोः by windgod, अन्यत्र:  anyone other than, हनूमतः by Hanuman, अन्यत्र:  none other than, यः this, महार्णवम्: great ocean, तरेत:  can  cross, हि: indeed, परिपश्यामि: not seen

40014137.author: Translation
40014137.content: "None else than Garuda or Vayu have I seen to have crossed this great ocean crossed by you, Hanuman."

40014138.author: पदार्थः
40014138.content: देवदानवयक्षाणाम्: for devas, danavas, yakshas, गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् gandharvas ,uragas , rakshasas, अप्रधृष्याम्: unimaginable to  cross, रावणेन: by Ravana, सुरक्षिताम्: highly protected, पुरीम्: city, सत्त्वम्: strength, आश्रित्य:  resorted, प्रविष्टः enter, को नाम: who indeed, श्वसन्: life, निष्क्रमेत्: can return

40014138.author: Translation
40014138.content: "Indeed, who has the strength to return alive after entering that city highly protected by Ravana. It is unimaginable even for devas, danavas, yakshas, gandharvas, uragas and rakshasas to cross."

40014139.author: पदार्थः
40014139.content: यः  he who , वीर्यबलसम्पन्नः abounding in valour and strength, हनूमतः Hanuman, नस्यात्: not possible , कः which सुदुराधर्षाम्: inaccessible, राक्षसैः by rakshasas, सुरक्षिताम्: highly protected, विशेत्: to enter

40014139.author: Translation
40014139.content: "Except for Hanuman, who is abounding in valour and strength, it is not possible for others to enter the inaccessible Lanka highly protected by rakshasas."

40014140.author: पदार्थः
40014140.content: हनुमता: Hanuman, विक्रमस्य: by his valour, सदृशम्:  mighty form, स्वबलम्: own strength, विधाय: what ought to be done,  सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, महत्: great, भृत्यकार्यम्: task assigned, कृतम्: carried out

40014140.author: Translation
40014140.content: "Hanuman, with his mighty form and valour not only carried out a great task assigned by Sugriva but also what had to be done as duty."

40014141.author: पदार्थः
40014141.content: यः he who, भृत्यः servant, दुष्करे: formidable, कर्मणि: task, भर्त्रा: master, नियुक्तः entrusted by, सन्: bestow, तत्: that, अनुरागेण: with love, कुर्यात्: does, तम्: him, पुरुषोत्तमम्: the best among men, आहुः is said to be

40014141.author: Translation
40014141.content: "He, who carries out  a formidable task entrusted to him by the master, with love is  said to be the best among men."

40014142.author: पदार्थः
40014142.content: यः he, भृत्यः is a servant, समर्थ: efficient, अभृत्य: not a servant, नियुक्तः told, नृपते: by king, प्रियम्:  dear, कार्यम्: work, परम्: other, नकुर्यात्: does not do, तम्: him, नरम्: mediocre, अहु: said to be

40014142.author: Translation
40014142.content: An efficient servant does not only do what is asked but also does the work dear to the king. One who does not do so is said to be mediocre.

40014143.author: पदार्थः
40014143.content: नियुक्तः one who is entrusted, यः he , भृत्यः servant, युक्तः capable, समर्थश्च:  who is efficient, नृपतेः by the king, कार्यम्: work, समाहितः who has agreed, कुर्यात्: not do the work , तम्: him, पुरुषाधमम्: lowly person, अहुः said  to be

40014143.author: Translation
40014143.content: "If one who is capable and efficient has been entrusted with a task by a king and fails to do the work agreed to, is said to be a lowly person."

40014144.author: पदार्थः
40014144.content: तत्: that, नियोगे:  assigned, नियुक्तेन:  which is favourable, हनूमता: Hanuman, कृत्यम्: had to be done, कृतम्:  having accomplished, आत्मा: on his own, लघुताम् :difficulty, न: not, नीतः  carried out  सुग्रीवश्चापि: even to Sugriva, तोषितः made happy

40014144.author: Translation
40014144.content: "Having done the task assigned to him, Hanuman carried out what had to be done and accomplished without difficulty. This made Sugriva also happy."

40014145.author: पदार्थः
40014145.content: वैदेह्या: Vaidehi's, दर्शनेन: by seeing, अद्य: now, अहं च: I am also, रघुवंशश्च: those of Raghu dynasty, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणश्च: Lakshmana's, धर्मतः rightfully, परिरक्षिताः  protected.

40014145.author: Translation
40014145.content: "On Hanuman finding Vaidehi, I and, mighty Lakshmana and the whole of Raghu dynasty are now rightfully protected."

40014146.author: पदार्थः
40014146.content: तु: on the other hand, प्रियाख्यातुः  who has spoken pleasing words, अस्य: to him, सदृशम्:  to see, प्रियम्: pleasing, यत् न कुर्मि:  not able to do to such person, इदम्: this, दीनस्य: piteous, मम: me, मनः mind भूयः further, प्रकर्षति: causing exceedingly

40014146.author: Translation
40014146.content: "On the other hand, it is a pity that I am not able to please such a person who has spoken pleasing words. Further this causes grief to me."

40014147.author: पदार्थः
40014147.content: मया: me, इमम्: such, कालम्: time, प्राप्य: attained, महात्मनः great person, तस्य: to him, हनूमतः Hanuman, सर्वस्वभूतः everything, एषः परिष्वङ्गः this  embrace, मे दत्तः that I give

40014147.author: Translation
40014147.content: "To such a great one who attained success at this time, everything can be given. I give my embrace."

40014148.author: पदार्थः
40014148.content: रामः Rama, इति: thus, उक्त्वा: having said, प्रीतिहृष्टाङ्गः  experiencing the joy of love all over the body, कृतात्मानम्: one who has accomplished, कृतकार्यम्: his duty, उपागतम्: returned back, तं हनूमन्तम्:  to him, Hanuman, परिषस्वजे: embraced.

40014148.author: Translation
40014148.content: Having said so, Rama experienced the joy of love all over his body and embraced Hanuman who returned successful.

40014149.author: पदार्थः
40014149.content: रघुनन्दनः Rama the delight of Raghu dynasty, ध्यात्वा: thought over , हरीणाम्: of monkeys, ईश्वरस्य: lord, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, उपशृण्वतः while listening, पुनः again, इदं वचनम्: these words, उवाच: spoke

40014149.author: Translation
40014149.content: Rama, the delight of Raghu dynasty thought over and said while Sugriva, the lord of monkeys was still listening.

40014150.author: पदार्थः
40014150.content: सीतायाः Sita's, परिमार्गणम्: in searching, सर्वथा: by all means, सुकृतम्: good work, तु: but( on the contrary), सागरम्: ocean, समासाद्य : having succeeded, मम मनः my mind, पुनः again, नष्टम्: fear

40014150.author: Translation
40014150.content: "By all means good work was done in searching for Sita. On the contrary, having succeeded, my mind is once again agitated when I think of (crossing) the ocean."

40014151.author: पदार्थः
40014151.content: समागताः come together, हरय: monkeys, दुष्पारस्य: difficult to cross, महाम्भसः vast ocean, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, दक्षिणम्: southern, पारम्: shore, कथम्: how can, गमिष्यन्ति: be able to cross

40014151.author: Translation
40014151.content: "How will all the monkeys together be able to cross to the southern shore of the vast ocean? It is difficult to cross."

40014152.author: पदार्थः
40014152.content: वैदेह्या: to Vaidehi, एषः all this , वृत्तान्तः matter, मम:  by me , गदितो:  told, यद्यपि: even though, हरीणाम्:  the monkeys, समुद्रपारगमने : to cross the ocean, उत्तरम्: enquired, किम्: what

40014152.author: Translation
40014152.content: "This has been told to me by Vaidehi. How will the monkeys cross the ocean(enquired Vaidehi)."

40014153.author: पदार्थः
40014153.content: शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of enemy, महाबाहुः  mighty armed, रामः Rama , हनूमन्तम्: at Hanuman, इति: thus, उक्त्वा: said, शोकसंभ्रान्तः agitated with sorrow, ध्यानम्: reflected, उपागमत्: approaching

40014153.author: Translation
40014153.content: Agitated with sorrow, mighty armed Rama, the destroyer of enemies approached Hanuman and reflected (about the crossing of the ocean). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे प्रथमस्सर्गः This is the end of the first Sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
